methods.label: Find the fraction traveled on pavement
methods.explanation:
The gravel and dirt portions occupy \(\tfrac13\) and \(\tfrac15\) of the whole trip. The paved portion is everything left over, so it accounts for
\[
1-\frac13-\frac15
=\frac{15-5-3}{15}
=\frac7{15}
\]
of the total distance.

Since this \(\tfrac7{15}\) portion is 20 miles, the whole trip is
\[
20\div\frac7{15}
=20\cdot\frac{15}{7}
=\frac{300}{7}\text{ miles}.
\]
The answer is \(\boxed{\frac{300}{7}}\) miles, choice \(\boxed{\text{E}}\).
